scope: European WVW ZZZ 1K Z layout, model year 2005 only, Mosel or Wolfsburg plant. Golf family, including variants; no engine, trim, fuel, equipment or exact build date inference. Do not reuse for North American 1K Jetta layouts or later Golf generations.
assessment: Combine the European Golf maintenance manual's positional layout and type example with Volkswagen's historical Golf V factory-type profile and the same-year Volkswagen year/plant code chart. Only year and plant facts are taken from the North American chart; its 1K=new Jetta model rule, engine and restraint rules do not apply to ZZZ filler layouts. This is a bounded synthesis of those sources, not a single universal OEM decoder table.
reuseBasis: Selected factual associations independently structured for interoperability, with exact source attribution. No manual, PDF, illustrations or complete table is redistributed; upstream rights are retained.
